rawFullPage.reason: the raw image intentionally compares different real workspace fixtures and licensed font/icon glyphs; it is retained as a non-passing diagnostic and is not represented as parity

intentionalDifferences.reason: OpenTag retains licensed Inter/system text and Lucide icons rather than copying the reference private font or glyph assets.
Visible controls keep at least 44 CSS px of touch height, including the 44px workspace switcher where the reference visible box measured about 42px.
Rows render the isolated local workspace's real channels, DMs, unread counts, saved state, and capabilities; reference workspace content is never copied into an OpenTag fixture.
